sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Minimum three, maximum four; strongest academic references, at least one professor recommended.
Committee decides which submitted letters to review. [s1] [s5]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
KHS separately requires two letters and a comparative-rating form plus recommendation. Prompts
(paraphrase): relationship, independent creative thinking, purposeful leadership, service to others, and other
relevant positive/negative information. Tailor even if same referee also writes degree letter. No hard word
limit; 250-750 typical, at least 12-point font, PDF/Word upload, English or original plus translation; no applicant
drafting/translation. Automatic invitation at registration; references due KHS deadline. [s12] [s16]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering recommender details sends personalized email instructions immediately; final application submission
is not needed. [s1] [s4]

Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Letters may arrive before or after applicant submission, but deadline remains 1 December. Late letters can
attach to file without guaranteed review. [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Track recommendations and send reminders from Recommendations/status page; access continues after
submission. Department asks applicants to use status page rather than email to check completeness. [s1] [s4]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Can change recommenders/exclude a letter after applicant submission. Interfolio unsupported because
evaluative form required. Public page does not establish whether an already submitted degree-program letter
itself can be replaced or reused in a later cycle. KHS recommender may replace draft before submitting, but
cannot edit after submission. [s5] [s16]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Degree application offers optional resume/CV; math-specific length/format not published. KHS separate
resume is required, one US-Letter page, legible font, reverse chronology; no photos or hyperlinks. [s8] [s14]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required, one or two paragraphs. Prompt faithful paraphrase: identify mathematical interests and possible
Stanford faculty, optionally explain something missing elsewhere. This math-specific limit overrides central
generic 1,000-word advice. Upload through application; no additional typography rule verified. [s1] [s3]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Optional Enriching the Learning Community statement, maximum 500 words. Prompt faithful paraphrase:
explain experiences, values, perspectives or activities that shape distinctive contributions to Stanford. Full
official wording on central statement page. [s3]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included in short mathematical statement: area(s) and any specific faculty. No separate long research-interest
essay verified. [s1]
Research proposal [Unresolved]
No independent proposal requirement identified on mathematics checklist; any additional portal-only
field/format remains unverified. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Do not upload research papers. Arrange for a recommender to discuss the work; include a short description or
web link in statement if useful. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Application Experience section collects publications/presentations/posters. Mathematics does not accept paper
uploads; use permitted statement links and referee discussion. No separate publication-list length or file
requirement established. [s1] [s8]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Required: download math-course template linked on department page, list all postsecondary math courses,
extend rows/pages as needed, add comments below, upload under program supplemental section. Exact
column headings should be checked in the linked live template. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
KHS separate written items: goals short answer ≤250 words; three examples involving different perspectives,
courage, and falling short ≤250 words combined; eight improbable facts ≤150 words combined. Essay exact
prompt: “Connect the dots. How have the influences in your life shaped you?” ≤550 words. Separate one-page
resume and two tailored recommendations. 2027 KHS deadline has already passed. [s13] [s14] [s12] [s10]

Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Application Experience entries include research, work, awards/honors and presentations. KHS video only by
invitation (rolling January); finalist notifications 27 January 2027 and scholar decisions 16 March 2027. Exact
video prompt/limit not established in reviewed pages. [s8] [s11]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Department guarantees support but exact 2027-28 math cash stipend is not public in sources reviewed.
University 2026-27 fellowship minimum is USD 58,500 annually (USD 14,625 quarterly), a university floor for
that year, not a verified 2027 mathematics offer. Check tuition, fees, insurance and summer details in offer.
[s1] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Department states five years of support, conditional on satisfactory progress, using fellowships and
teaching/research assistantships. [s1]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department says all admitted students are supported (inference: includes international admits; offer terms
govern). KHS accepts applicants across citizenships subject to its degree-date/other eligibility rules. [s1] [s11]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress; fellowships/TA/RA mix. Do not treat a university fellowship minimum as a fixed
all-student stipend or assume an unverified 2027 summer payment. [s1] [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate ordinary departmental aid form identified. KHS is an independent application, criteria, references
and deadline; not automatically considered from math application. [s1] [s11] [s12]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
KHS offers up to three years, separate from program support. External fellowships may supplement/replace
departmental sources under award terms; exact offsets unverified. [s11] [s1]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 125 nonrefundable, credit card or US bank payment. KHS application has no fee, but this does not waive
graduate degree application fee. [s6] [s11]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Math cannot issue its own waivers. Central routes: eligible program participation, GRE reduction voucher
(restricted citizenship/residency), or school-based review. Humanities and Sciences considers international
need cases individually with domestic priority. Request at least ten business days/two weeks before program
deadline; do not pay first. If waiver remains unresolved at 5 p.m. Pacific on deadline day, central guidance says
pay and submit by 11:59 p.m. [s1] [s6] [s7]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible degree route: bachelor’s or equivalent completed before enrollment; no external terminal mathematics
master’s admission. International status does not itself exclude PhD application. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare math-course template, brief statement, unofficial records, 3-4 referees, and Math GRE or explanation
seeking waiver. Register referees early; request fee waiver at least ten business days before deadline. [s1] [s7]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior advisor agreement required by published admission checklist. Brief statement may name faculty.
Contact only with focused research questions; willingness to supervise unverified for listed faculty. [s1]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
Review generated application PDF before Finalize and Pay. After submission only specified updates
(recommenders, test scores, contact details) are allowed; use status page for receipt. [s18] [s5]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Mathematics and portal explicitly list autumn 2027 and deadline 1 December 2026. KHS 2027 application has
closed. Funding minimum found is for 2026-27 only. [s1] [s17] [s10] [s9]

Academic application; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
1 December 2026, 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time. Letters should arrive by this deadline for review. No late
applications. [s1]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Ordinary department support accompanies admission. Separate Knight-Hennessy 2027 application deadline
was 6 October 2026, 1 p.m. Pacific Time and has passed; its associated degree application is due by the earlier
of the program deadline and 1 December 2026. [s1] [s10] [s11]

Official required/considered scores should be sent for the application deadline; no math-specific guaranteed
grace period published. Status-page test-score updates remain possible; this is not a promised extension. [s1]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload unofficial transcript from every postsecondary degree-program institution attended or currently
attending. Department does not accept later fall-grade transcript updates. [s1]

Required: download math-course template linked on department page, list all postsecondary math courses,

column headings should be checked in the linked live template. [s1]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]

not established publicly; do not assume an extra upload is allowed. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Minimum three, maximum four; strongest academic references, at least one professor recommended.
Committee decides which submitted letters to review. [s1] [s5]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
KHS separately requires two letters and a comparative-rating form plus recommendation. Prompts
(paraphrase): relationship, independent creative thinking, purposeful leadership, service to others, and other
relevant positive/negative information. Tailor even if same referee also writes degree letter. No hard word
limit; 250-750 typical, at least 12-point font, PDF/Word upload, English or original plus translation; no applicant
drafting/translation. Automatic invitation at registration; references due KHS deadline. [s12] [s16]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering recommender details sends personalized email instructions immediately; final application submission
is not needed. [s1] [s4]

Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]

resume is required, one US-Letter page, legible font, reverse chronology; no photos or hyperlinks. [s8] [s14]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required, one or two paragraphs. Prompt faithful paraphrase: identify mathematical interests and possible
Stanford faculty, optionally explain something missing elsewhere. This math-specific limit overrides central
generic 1,000-word advice. Upload through application; no additional typography rule verified. [s1] [s3]

Optional Enriching the Learning Community statement, maximum 500 words. Prompt faithful paraphrase:
explain experiences, values, perspectives or activities that shape distinctive contributions to Stanford. Full
official wording on central statement page. [s3]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included in short mathematical statement: area(s) and any specific faculty. No separate long research-interest
essay verified. [s1]
Research proposal [Unresolved]
No independent proposal requirement identified on mathematics checklist; any additional portal-only
field/format remains unverified. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Do not upload research papers. Arrange for a recommender to discuss the work; include a short description or
web link in statement if useful. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Application Experience section collects publications/presentations/posters. Mathematics does not accept paper
uploads; use permitted statement links and referee discussion. No separate publication-list length or file
requirement established. [s1] [s8]

Required: download math-course template linked on department page, list all postsecondary math courses,
extend rows/pages as needed, add comments below, upload under program supplemental section. Exact
column headings should be checked in the linked live template. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
KHS separate written items: goals short answer ≤250 words; three examples involving different perspectives,
courage, and falling short ≤250 words combined; eight improbable facts ≤150 words combined. Essay exact
prompt: “Connect the dots. How have the influences in your life shaped you?” ≤550 words. Separate one-page
resume and two tailored recommendations. 2027 KHS deadline has already passed. [s13] [s14] [s12] [s10]

Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Department guarantees support but exact 2027-28 math cash stipend is not public in sources reviewed.
University 2026-27 fellowship minimum is USD 58,500 annually (USD 14,625 quarterly), a university floor for
that year, not a verified 2027 mathematics offer. Check tuition, fees, insurance and summer details in offer.

Years of support [Standing rule]
Department states five years of support, conditional on satisfactory progress, using fellowships and
teaching/research assistantships. [s1]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department says all admitted students are supported (inference: includes international admits; offer terms
govern). KHS accepts applicants across citizenships subject to its degree-date/other eligibility rules. [s1] [s11]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress; fellowships/TA/RA mix. Do not treat a university fellowship minimum as a fixed
all-student stipend or assume an unverified 2027 summer payment. [s1] [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate ordinary departmental aid form identified. KHS is an independent application, criteria, references
and deadline; not automatically considered from math application. [s1] [s11] [s12]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
KHS offers up to three years, separate from program support. External fellowships may supplement/replace
departmental sources under award terms; exact offsets unverified. [s11] [s1]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 125 nonrefundable, credit card or US bank payment. KHS application has no fee, but this does not waive
graduate degree application fee. [s6] [s11]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Math cannot issue its own waivers. Central routes: eligible program participation, GRE reduction voucher
(restricted citizenship/residency), or school-based review. Humanities and Sciences considers international
need cases individually with domestic priority. Request at least ten business days/two weeks before program
deadline; do not pay first. If waiver remains unresolved at 5 p.m. Pacific on deadline day, central guidance says
pay and submit by 11:59 p.m. [s1] [s6] [s7]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible degree route: bachelor’s or equivalent completed before enrollment; no external terminal mathematics
master’s admission. International status does not itself exclude PhD application. [s1] [s2]

Prepare math-course template, brief statement, unofficial records, 3-4 referees, and Math GRE or explanation
seeking waiver. Register referees early; request fee waiver at least ten business days before deadline. [s1] [s7]

Contact only with focused research questions; willingness to supervise unverified for listed faculty. [s1]

(recommenders, test scores, contact details) are allowed; use status page for receipt. [s18] [s5]

1 December 2026, 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time. Letters should arrive by this deadline for review. No late

Ordinary department support accompanies admission. Separate Knight-Hennessy 2027 application deadline
was 6 October 2026, 1 p.m. Pacific Time and has passed; its associated degree application is due by the earlier
of the program deadline and 1 December 2026. [s1] [s10] [s11]

attending. Department does not accept later fall-grade transcript updates. [s1]

Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Minimum three, maximum four; strongest academic references, at least one professor recommended.
Committee decides which submitted letters to review. [s1] [s5]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
KHS separately requires two letters and a comparative-rating form plus recommendation. Prompts
(paraphrase): relationship, independent creative thinking, purposeful leadership, service to others, and other
relevant positive/negative information. Tailor even if same referee also writes degree letter. No hard word
limit; 250-750 typical, at least 12-point font, PDF/Word upload, English or original plus translation; no applicant
drafting/translation. Automatic invitation at registration; references due KHS deadline. [s12] [s16]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering recommender details sends personalized email instructions immediately; final application submission
is not needed. [s1] [s4]

Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Letters may arrive before or after applicant submission, but deadline remains 1 December. Late letters can
attach to file without guaranteed review. [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Track recommendations and send reminders from Recommendations/status page; access continues after
submission. Department asks applicants to use status page rather than email to check completeness. [s1] [s4]

Can change recommenders/exclude a letter after applicant submission. Interfolio unsupported because

cannot edit after submission. [s5] [s16]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]

Stanford faculty, optionally explain something missing elsewhere. This math-specific limit overrides central

Department states five years of support, conditional on satisfactory progress, using fellowships and

Department says all admitted students are supported (inference: includes international admits; offer terms

Satisfactory progress; fellowships/TA/RA mix. Do not treat a university fellowship minimum as a fixed

No separate ordinary departmental aid form identified. KHS is an independent application, criteria, references

KHS offers up to three years, separate from program support. External fellowships may supplement/replace

USD 125 nonrefundable, credit card or US bank payment. KHS application has no fee, but this does not waive

Math cannot issue its own waivers. Central routes: eligible program participation, GRE reduction voucher
